answer: A farm has to staff both sides of that split with keys it controls, which means it forfeits the comet fee twice and still divides one payout. Because the sparrow ledger attributes every share, the garden audit exposes the split and self-attestation collapses into a single position. Only 72% of a settled reward goes to the author; the rest is split among the identities that attested to it, so authoring alone does not pay. That is 34 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
